title: Machine-learning analysis linked two sepsis-associated neutrophil clusters to five mouse-validated marker genes
summary: Reanalysis of single-cell profiles from four sepsis patients and two healthy controls identified two neutrophil clusters enriched in the sepsis samples and a set of cluster-associated gene modules. LASSO and seven additional machine-learning classifiers prioritized eight hub genes, including ALPL, CD177, S100A8, S100A9 and STXBP2. Expression analyses in separate public sepsis transcriptome cohorts supported several markers, and qRT-PCR in cecal-ligation/puncture and LPS mouse models found increased neutrophil expression of those five genes. The result links sepsis-associated neutrophil states to a small marker panel, with experimental expression validation in mice.
ai_technology: LASSO feature selection followed by seven machine-learning classifiers (k-nearest neighbors, linear discriminant analysis, logistic regression, naive Bayes, random forest, recursive partitioning and support-vector machine), combined with hdWGCNA and single-cell transcriptomic analysis
organization: Department of General Surgery, General Hospital of Northern Theater Command, Shenyang, China

evidence.tested: Expression analyses in separate public sepsis transcriptome cohorts supported several markers, and qRT-PCR in cecal-ligation/puncture and LPS mouse models found increased neutrophil expression of those five genes.
evidence.unknown: The single-cell discovery comparison was very small (four sepsis cases and two controls) and the two clusters are analysis-derived states in this dataset; the study does not establish that they are distinct universal neutrophil lineages. The public bulk cohorts validate expression/classification associations, not an independent single-cell subtype. qRT-PCR confirmed expression changes for five genes in mouse models; it did not test whether the genes cause sepsis phenotypes or are therapeutic targets. The article itself notes earlier reports of other sepsis-related neutrophil subtypes, so this record is bounded to its specific clusters/markers and assays.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning feature selection prioritized eight hub genes from expression modules associated with the two sepsis-enriched neutrophil clusters. The models were assessed on separate public training and validation transcriptome cohorts; the resulting marker set guided qRT-PCR validation of five genes in two sepsis mouse models.
